newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen volatile amid profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen volatile amid profit-taking.

text.p: Taiwan share prices are expected to be in volatile trade on Thursday amid profit-taking pressure facing the 8,300-point resistance, brokers said.
On Wednesday, the index ended up 8.43 points at 8,255.07, a six-year high. A 8,210-8,320 range was seen for Thursday.

Brokers noted net selling on Wednsesday by local mutual funds. "Investors are also concerned that the central bank continued to issue negotiable certificates of deposits to tighten liquidity," said National Securities analyst Eric Liu.
"The market is overheated in the short run, but most believe its long-term outlook is still good."
